task_completion.description: Open the pUC19.gb file in the UGENE software interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE window is visible showing 'pUC19' in the project view or sequence editor.

task_completion.description: Annotate the sequence with EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII restriction sites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The restriction site manager or sequence view shows EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII labels/markers on the sequence.

task_completion.description: Generate and display a circular plasmid map showing CDS features (bla, lacZ) and the three restriction sites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A circular map view is active in UGENE showing labels for 'bla', 'lacZ', 'EcoRI', 'BamHI', and 'HindIII'.

task_completion.description: Export the circular view as an image to the specified results directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or file explorer shows 'pUC19_map.png' being saved to ~/UGENE_Data/cloning/results/.

task_completion.description: Create a text report listing the exact genomic coordinates for the three cut sites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file preview shows 'map_details.txt' containing the names and numerical positions of EcoRI, BamHI, and HindIII.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform cloning tasks rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with UGENE menus, buttons, and the circular map interface.

integrity.description: The exported image is a genuine export from UGENE, not a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The circular map in the screenshot matches the standard UGENE visual style (colors, fonts, and layout).

integrity.description: The agent derived coordinates from the software rather than copy-pasting from external metadata.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the restriction sites in the UGENE interface to identify their positions.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses NCBI M77789.2. For this specific sequence, the verified cut site positions are: EcoRI at 285 and BamHI at 264. Note that these differ from some other pUC19 variants (like Addgene L09137) which place EcoRI at 396 and BamHI at 417. The agent should report the coordinates corresponding to the M77789.2 file provided in the environment.
